photos.desc: Map of the fossil locality where the holootype specimen of Tongtianlong limosus was found near Ganzhou, Jiangxi Province, southern China. The solid five-pointed star represents the fossil site. Modifi

The photograph (a) and line drawing (b) of the skull: Tongtianlong limosus gen. et sp. nov. in right lateral view. Abbreviations: aof, antorbital fenestra; bc, braincase; d, dentary; emf, external man

The holotype of Tongtianlong limosus gen. et sp. nov.: whole skeleton (a), close-up of furcula (b), close up of humerus (c), dorsal view of skull (d) and dorsal view of middle cervical vertebrae. Scal
